```yaml
name: Playwright Docs Check
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui/**'

jobs:
  playwright-docs-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: |
          cd openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright tests for docs
        run: |
          cd openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui
          npx playwright test --grep="docs" --reporter=html

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
```
